questions.question: What did Jesus predict would happen to the temple buildings?
options: They would be converted to Roman use
Not one stone would be left on another
questions.answer: Not one stone would be left on another

questions.question: Jesus said no one knows the day or hour of his return, not even whom?
options: The scribes or the teachers of the law
The angels in heaven or the Son
The kings of the earth or their armies
The prophets of old or the priests
questions.answer: The angels in heaven or the Son
